## Appendix: ID Reference

`{hierarchy-prefix}` is the dot-free hierarchy path of this epic as registered in `artifacts.toml` — for the home epic of the student MiniApp under the superapp platform it is `superapp-student-home`.

|------------|---------|---------|

| `cpt-{hierarchy-prefix}-fr-{slug}` | `cpt-superapp-student-home-fr-streak` | Functional requirement |
| `cpt-{hierarchy-prefix}-nfr-{slug}` | `cpt-superapp-student-home-nfr-cold-start` | Non-functional requirement |
| `cpt-{hierarchy-prefix}-state-{slug}` | `cpt-superapp-student-home-state-offline` | State machine |
| `cpt-{hierarchy-prefix}-widget-{slug}` | `cpt-superapp-student-home-widget-progress` | UI component |
| `cpt-{hierarchy-prefix}-usecase-{slug}` | `cpt-superapp-student-home-usecase-open-course` | Use case |
